name: uc41_display
notes: Universal Controller 4.1 (Tip Charger) display - do NOT flash onto a Plasma StandAlone panel. 4.1.41B TEST BUILD: tip sensor now takes the MEDIAN of 9 quick reads (4.1.39 used the lowest, so a tips-out under plasma read 0 and the plasma ran to the time limit), 3-tick debounce on fire/stop, plus main-loop fixes (smoothed power/vac flow, timer shut-offs, stop from any screen, pump stays on mid-cycle). On-screen label still reads 4.1.38 (graphics unchanged). Program only (.4XE), uSD untouched. Flash over a direct 4D USB programmer.
